problemsFixed: Fact 3 and Fact 4 in the draft reference The Washington Post and 21 November 2026, but the only provided source (S2) is from The Jerusalem Post and concerns Trump's comments on Iran. No Washington Post source is provided.
The draft body combines two unrelated events (Trump/Iran and White House contractor policy) reported on the same day, but only one event is supported by the sources.
The context section invents a connection between the two events that is not in the sources.
The dek and body contain evaluative language ('more reasonable but difficult to negotiate with') that must be attributed.
The draft ends with an evaluative summary sentence ('The two developments were reported on the same day...').

The headline references Iran's new leadership; the source only says Trump says the leadership is 'more reasonable but difficult to negotiate with'. The headline must reflect the source's exact claim, not a rephrased conclusion.
The draft repeats the same opening structure ('Donald Trump stated...', 'The statement was reported...') in facts and body.
